note: A page is at most one hundred entries: each carries two whole Trust Task documents.
0.1's `pageSize` does not exist in 0.2; it is `limit`.
The filters name DIDs: a relationship is filtered by the DID the VWC names, not by a vault handle.
A list reads the vault and changes nothing: there is no member to archive or delete what it finds.
`nextCursor` is absent on the last page, never `null`.
0.1's `truncated` does not exist in 0.2; the presence of `nextCursor` says the VTA stopped early.
